text: 1. Photocopy of valid ordinary passport (expiry date should be after October 31, 2023).2. Applicants currently residing in China must provide a copy of the page containing a valid visa or residence permit.3. Applicants in the category of “Eligibility and Requirements 2” must provide:(1) copies of all passports he/she used to have.(2) all copies of visa or residence permit relevant to stay in Mainland China, Hong Kong, Macau or Taiwan.4. High school diploma or proof of impending graduation (for applicants in their final year of study).5. High school transcripts.6. Physical examination form7. Certificate of Non-criminal Record.8. Financial Certification/Bank Statement(5,000 USD or above).9. Personal Statement: Introduce yourself in details, explain your understanding of China, the reasons and your expectations for studying at HUST.10. Personal Introduction Video: Please record and submit a video in English or Chinese within 60 seconds.11. Language Proficiency:TOEFL 80 or above;IELTS 5.5 or above;other certificates of the same proficiency level which are accepted by HUST;The previous degree education was instructed in English or mother tongue is English, the English proficiency certificate can be exempted after confirmation.12. Other supporting materials that can prove learning ability and comprehensive quality, such as award certificates, scientific and technological achievements, published papers, participation in activities, etc. 5 or more personal art works are required to apply for architecture or design related majors.13. Applicants who are under the age of 18 by September 1, 2023 should submit the power of attorney of guardian and the letter of guarantee of guardians in China.*The above materials shall be provided in Chinese or English. For other languages, please provide official notarized translations.
